concept.title: Smart temperature comfort control system (for driver’s seat)

keywords.indexterm: automatic climate control system smart temperature comfort control system (for driver’s seat)
smart temperature comfort control system (for driver’s seat)

conbody.p: When the vehicle is in ON position and climate control is set to AUTO, the smart temperature comfort control system automatically controls the driver’s seat warmer, air ventilated seat , and steering wheel heater according to the temperature both inside and outside the vehicle.
The steering wheel heater, seat warmer, and seat ventilation default to off whenever you restart the vehicle.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleSeatsHeating/VentilationAUTO Controls from the infotainment system screen.
Then, select Climate ControlSettingsSteering Wheel WarmerSeat WarmerVentilation from the infotainment system screen.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after a software update. For more details, refer to the user’s manual in the infotainment system or the quick reference guide.
